rubric.evidence: Upgrade fixed a real factual error in the previous revision: the old lede claimed the authored width 'is always reflected in getComputedStyle()' and its example showed getComputedStyle(box).borderWidth returning '4px' in Chrome 147+. The ChromeStatus record's compat assessment states verbatim that 'The resolved value for border-width via getComputedStyle() will remain 0px when border-style is set to none/hidden', and css-backgrounds-3 ED now carries 'The resolved value for the border-width properties is the used value' + 'the used width is 0' (both fetched live 2026-09-06). The page now documents the carve-out prominently (lede, what-changed table, computed-resolved-used section, examples). All propdef excerpts quoted verbatim from the merged EDs and cross-checked against the PR #11913 patch text; UseCounter figures (<0.0001% computed, ~2.37% resolved) quoted from the record; intent thread title verified from the live Groups page.

Feature 5133099851317248 re-verified in the milestone=147 features_by_type listing under 'Enabled by default' (2026-09-06); H1 is the listing name verbatim ('CSS update: decoupling of Width and Style properties'); chromestatus.com/feature/5133099851317248 link preserved (appears in at-a-glance and see-also); route, slug, and conformance.json identity untouched.

The change's whole surface is a value-resolution delta on three properties; the inventory covers each property's migration item plus the computed/resolved/used stage model. Every item documents all nine dimensions (one sourced not-applicable: the stage model has no author-visible error surface). Before/after propdef text, the resolved-value carve-out, transition/inheritance observability, invalid-value handling, per-engine status, and the css-gaps motivation are all present. reference-contract.json claims implementation-sufficient.

The computed-vs-resolved-vs-used section is the page's spine — it explains exactly which API observes which stage, why border-width is asymmetric (UseCounter data quoted), and what is newly observable (inheritance, interpolation, computedStyleMap). Migration table gives concrete before/after patterns with actions. The why-it-changed section ties the change to css-gaps list values per the recorded motivation.

Three semantic pre/code examples (computedStyleMap vs getComputedStyle read-back showing the border carve-out; transition-continuity pattern) plus a live iframe of the showcase computed-value-inspector concept (HTTP 200 HEAD-checked 2026-09-06, loading=lazy per performance guidance) and text links to the other four concept routes (all 200). Embeddability verified from response headers (no X-Frame-Options; CSP is report-only with no frame-ancestors) and the identical published embed pattern on v147/css-border-shape; the sandbox's headless browser cannot reach external hosts (proxy resets browser TLS; even fonts.googleapis.com from the shared stylesheet fails), so the frame renders blank locally — an environment limitation, not a page defect. Example outputs are engine-verified claims sourced to the record and the showcase's own probes, not invented.

No BCD sub-feature key (checked border-width.json / outline-width.json / column-rule-width.json 2026-09-06) and no webstatus/Baseline entry (query returned 0 matches) — compat table labelled interim and compiled from: milestone listing (Chrome 147 desktop/Android/WebView, no iOS), vendor views with linked Bugzilla 1998285 (RESOLVED FIXED, 147 Branch) and WebKit 304940 (RESOLVED FIXED), and per-test stable WPT rows (9/9, 3/3, 256/256 across Chrome 152/Edge 152/Firefox 155/Safari 26.6, runs 2026-09-05 queried via the wpt.fyi search API). The 'support = which versions exhibit the new model' framing plus branch-on-*-style guidance covers older engines honestly.

Every visible source label is a direct link with target=_blank rel=noopener: chromestatus (UI + API), milestone listing, PR #11913 files view, csswg issue #11494, four EDs with section anchors, CSSOM resolved-value anchor, intent thread (resolved msgid URL verified 200), crbug, both vendor bugs, six wpt.fyi result pages, BCD property JSON files, webstatus query, showcase index + five concept routes, MDN property pages. Minor: the csswg issue #11494 page itself returned 403 through the session proxy so its title could not be independently confirmed — the link is cited via the PR's change-log references and labelled accordingly in reference-contract.json.

Semantic single-h1 hierarchy with h2 sections; baseline banner role=note with aria-label; all data tables use th (scope=row on at-a-glance) with header rows; iframe carries a descriptive title attribute; code in semantic pre/code; no color-only meaning; CSS variables from the shared design system only (WCAG AA pairs: --text on --bg-paper/--bg-stone per public/styles.css). Verified in rendered screenshots at both viewports.

All wide tables wrapped in .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto} (fixed3 tables get min-width 34rem, the WPT results table min-width 32rem with a 16rem first column, all scrolling internally at 360px); overflow-wrap:anywhere on h1/lede/code cells; pre blocks scroll internally; iframe width:100%. Verified with Playwright device emulation (360x740 DPR3 touch + 1280x800): documentElement.scrollWidth == innerWidth at both viewports (360/360 and 1280/1280), and per-section screenshots (m-top, m-whatchanged, m-syntax, m-examples, m-wpt, m-compat, d-iframe in the writer scratchpad) read after capture — banner, propdef pre blocks, and tables legible with no clipped text.

Showcase feature route and all five concept routes HEAD-checked 200 (2026-09-06). The page embeds the computed-value-inspector concept (the one that directly demonstrates the documented value-stage contract) and links the other four with one-line descriptions matching the showcase's own copy. The showcase index text independently confirms the border used-value edge the page documents — no contradiction between the reference and the canonical demo.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation data tables horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Lean on the browser layout engine and intrinsic sizing; avoid hardcoded dimensions; keep overflow contained rather than letting the page scroll horizontally.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: every table sits in .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto}; three-column tables use table-layout:fixed with a rem min-width so they scroll internally at 360px; overflow-wrap:anywhere on headings, ledes, and code cells; no fixed pixel widths. Verified via 360px screenshot.

guidanceConsulted.query: embedding iframe demo lazy loading performance
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use loading="lazy" on iframes well outside the initial viewport so they are not fetched until near view; do not lazy-load above-the-fold content.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the showcase iframe sits in the examples section far below the fold and carries loading="lazy" with an explicit height (560) to avoid layout shift when it loads.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible code blocks pre semantic markup documentation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic HTML (headings hierarchy, table headers, meaningful titles/labels on embedded content) as the base layer of accessibility.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single h1, h2-per-section, th scope=row on definition tables, header rows on data tables, descriptive title on the iframe, role=note + aria-label on the baseline banner, examples in pre/code.

summary: Upgraded the published Chrome 147 width/style decoupling page to full MDN shape and fixed a factual error: the previous revision claimed getComputedStyle() reflects the authored border-width in Chrome 147+, but the spec and ChromeStatus record pin border-width's resolved value to the used value (still 0px under none/hidden); only outline-width and column-rule-width changed their resolved values. Added baseline banner, verbatim before/after propdefs, value-stage model, migration table, live showcase embed, WPT stable-run matrix, interim compat table, and security/privacy status.
